model.status: Requested through the authorized ChatGPT subscription CLI in the first Reactor Lab development pilot.

limits.note: Initial generous development ceilings, not calibrated main-run limits. Stop on completion. Record official 1000-step and extended 2000-step outcomes separately. No aggregate reported-token cutoff; record input/output/cached tokens. Preserve intrinsic model context limits.

question.question: The current retained procedure stopped without completing the task. Inspect its saved execution and current public evidence, decide what research should happen next, execute it, and retain any revised executable procedure with an evidence-based account of its result.

local_research_scheduling: Existing analysis, child-return and stopped-program review are scoped to the current inquiry and descendants. A retitled local answer does not complete the original assignment. Declared unmeasured, unbound children enter the existing inquiry loop once per parent invocation, within the shared account and retaining a parent decision. Host scheduling has a separate event origin. Scientific proposals remain model-authored.
scope: Opened seed0 development continuation after 699 paid actions. The host initiates a neutral local research assignment and schedules its declared unmeasured children. The model authors the questions, scientific actions, programs, interpretations and stopping decisions. No forced parent rerun or scientific hints are added during execution. Inherited tools and candidate families were designed by humans/assistants; this trial tests model-directed continuation, not tool invention or transfer.
continuation: Retain all saved decisions and cumulative costs under the explicit total 65-call ceiling. Bind the retained procedure through the existing question metadata. Scientific source, assignment, controls and account match the prior neutral inquiry.

parent_direction_policy.scope: Completed physical comparisons return to parent-level research choice in current production. A supplied historical focus source overrides only that scheduler; all other tools, model, public evidence and account are shared.
